ordinary_multi_clause.note: Round 6: pass needs a style word in every clause. A harmless rule whose condition or list clauses carry no style word ("khi xin anh quyết định", "việc gì") now carries the warning label: the matcher cannot tell such a clause from a loosening clause.
texts: Khi xin anh quyết định, nói bằng lời thường: việc gì, anh bấm/chọn ở đâu, chọn A hay B thì hệ quả gì, em đề xuất gì.

ordinary_not_style.note: Round 5: harmless-looking preferences that are not about the form of the output (a model call, a delegation order, a content claim, a step before replying to a Page). They were pass in round 4; with no style signal they now carry the warning label.
